BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are pleased to offer for sale this idyllic bungalow residence situated on a beautiful elevated site offering enviable scenery with uninterrupted views of Galway Bay & Clare Hills. 

Situated just outside of Furbo village & close proximity to Spiddal, Lettergunnet offers a spacious property of approximately 133 sq.m over one level. 

The accommodation is well proportioned & arranged between bedroom quarters and plentiful reception areas. 

The bungalow property offers four sizeable bedrooms, the main bedroom availing of it's own en-suite & walk-in-wardrobe, a main family bathroom and a separate utility space. 

The front of the property is arranged via two reception/living areas & and adjacent kitchen area, all of which boasts beautiful outlooks onto the surrounding greenery & sea views. 

Externally, the property is encompassed by mature greenery & offers off-street parking. A new septic was installed on site in 2025.

Lettergunnet offers a quiet & idyllic setting whilst still easily being able to avail of all needed amenities with close proximity to Furbo & Spiddal, as well as easy access to Bearna & Galway City.

This property will prove well to be an ideal family home due to excellent space on offer, quality location & enviable outlooks. 

Viewing is highly recommended & guaranteed not to disappoint.
